name: science-studio
description: Research-agent platform for computational life-science R&D.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n service,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:service" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @science-studio/record && npm run build -w @science-studio/transport && npm run build -w @science-studio/workspace && npm run build -w @science-studio/cron && npm run build -w @science-studio/hpc && npm run build -w @science-studio/contract-tests && npm run build -w @science-studio/transport-client && npm run build -w @science-studio/molql-viewer && npm run build -w @science-studio/msa-viewer && npm run build -w @science-studio/transport-openclaw && npm run build -w @science-studio/transport-dsh && npm run build -w @science-studio/transport-service && npm run typecheck:tests
scripts.dev:dsh: concurrently -k -n service,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:dsh:service" "npm run dev:web"
